spans.text: Shortly after the Commander escapes the hotel...
...The Commander is discussing the assault plan with the Griffin team at the secret rendezvous point.
Next, we'll assign roles. DEFY, M16, you'll launch the assault on the base with me and Dandelion.
M16's team attacked the production line not long ago. Even if William is still at the base, he already knows we're coming.
But as I said before, William and I have reached a tacit understanding on one point.
We both want each other dead. And to achieve that, neither of us wants the Earl interfering.
The Commander taps the tactical tablet firmly.
So William won't report this to the Earl, but he has definitely prepared traps inside the base.
They point at the map of the base and draw a circle around the laboratory.
We need meticulous planning and preparation.
William may be arrogant, but he's not stupid.
With our current strength, this is practically a gamble.
This final battle will be difficult.
The discussion comes to a lull. Everyone remains silent, waiting for the Commander's final decision.
...Actually, I have an idea, but I'll need your approval... and a small favor.
What do you have in mind, M16?
First, I need Dandelion's help.
M16 reaches out to tease Dandelion, who is perched on the Commander's head, only to have her hand slapped away by the disgruntled Dinergate.
M16, if you're asking for my help, why do you need the Commander's approval?
Huh? Aren't you basically their electronic pet now?
Dandelion leaps onto M16's head and pulls at her hair angrily. M16 simply grabs the Dinergate and lifts her overhead.
What's the plan?
I want to go somewhere with Dandelion.
If things go well, we might bring back a force strong enough to turn the tide.
You don't mean...!
M16 nods. The Commander immediately understands.
How long do you need?
Not sure. I need to scout on-site, but I'll return as soon as possible.
How soon depends entirely on how good a job this electronic pet does.
The Commander checks the coordinates on the tablet, then accepts the proposal.
Okay, change of plan.
M16, Dandelion, you depart immediately.
DEFY will move with me to the base first. We'll draw William's attention, delay his response, and create an opening for the factory strike teams.
The Commander turns to Kalina. Her unease is unmistakable in those familiar eyes.
Kalin, when we engage William, he will definitely try to secure an escape route.
So Paradeus' factories and reserves must be destroyed.
I know this is asking a lot, but I need you, 404, and Tokarev's team to handle it.
Kalin nods, then shakes her head firmly.
...Commander, please let me go to the base with you!
She looks at the Commander almost beseechingly. She doesn't want to leave their side again.
A faint premonition grips her—if she leaves now, they may never meet again.
Letting Kalin go with you shouldn't be a problem, right? With us and Tokarev's team, destroying the factories should be manageable.
Is that okay... Commander?
The plea in her eyes makes their heart falter.
What should they do?
Then...
A sudden, inexplicable sense of foreboding rises within them.
She must not be allowed near the base.
Absolutely not.
You can't come with us to the base, Kalin.
Once you're done destroying the factories, move to a safe location and await orders.
Kalin freezes, as if unable to believe what she's hearing.
Make sure she stays safe.
UMP45 shrugs, silently accepting the responsibility.
All units, move out.
The T-Dolls spring into action. M16 disappears into the night with Dandelion still bickering atop her head.
The Commander turns toward the vehicle, but Kalina grabs their arm from behind. Her hand trembles slightly.
You... you'll come back, right, Commander?
Her voice sounds casual, but the faint tremor at the end betrays her emotions.
The night is too dark to see her expression.
...Yeah. Wait for me.
Her grip loosens. She says nothing more and turns back toward Tokarev's team.
The Commander faintly hears a whisper coming from behind.
It's a promise.
The words dissolve into the wind, so soft they almost never existed.
The night grows deeper.
The vehicle carrying the Commander and DEFY soon reaches the outskirts of the base.
Commander, there's no response from inside the base.
Hm. But William knows we're coming. Stay alert.
Status of the other teams?
Kalin and 404 have begun destroying the factories as planned. No updates from M16 yet.
As for us...
Alarms blare within the base Before AK-12 can finish.
Massive searchlights snap on and lock onto them all at once.
—! We've been spotted. All units, engage! Hold your positions!
